name: Bingles' Blastencapper
summary: Troggs hold Bingles' Blastencapper after his gyrocopter fell into the Loch. Without it, Bingles' plans to aid Gnomeregan's liberation are in danger.

sections.title: A Volatile Invention
sections.body: Bingles Blastenheimer built the Blastencapper to strike from the air at the troggs and leper gnomes who overran Gnomeregan. Mechanical failure sent his gyrocopter into the Loch, but Bingles survived. Troggs from the northern islands raided the wreckage and carried the volatile weapon to their camps.

sections.title: Air Support for Gnomeregan
sections.body: Bingles needs the Blastencapper to help retake Gnomeregan. The exiled gnomes are preparing to reclaim their radioactive home, and he counts on his gyrocopter and signature munitions for the air assault. In trogg hands, the explosive could accidentally cause a catastrophe in Loch Modan. Recovering it would preserve a valuable weapon for the gnomish resistance.

faq.answer: Bingles Blastenheimer made the Blastencapper to strike from the air at the troggs and leper gnomes occupying Gnomeregan.

faq.q: How did the Blastencapper end up in the Loch?
aliases: why is it in the loch
faq.answer: Bingles crashed his gyrocopter into the Loch. Troggs from nearby islands raided the wreckage and carried off his tools, including the explosive.
Troggs from the Loch’s northern islands took the Blastencapper from the wreckage and guard it in their camp.

faq.q: Why does Bingles need the Blastencapper returned?
faq.answer: Bingles needs the Blastencapper and his tools to repair his gyrocopter and launch an aerial assault in support of Gnomeregan’s reclamation.

angles.text: Every tool and munition matters as the gnomes struggle to reclaim Gnomeregan. Recovering Bingles’ explosive could let gnomish aerial ingenuity strike back at the trogg invaders.
The Blastencapper shows gnomish engineering flair: complex and explosive, it can devastate from high above.
